title: Hybrid Agentic RAG
description: A deployable hybrid retrieval-augmented generation system combining BM25 lexical search with semantic dense embeddings fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
summary: A production-ready RAG system that fuses BM25 keyword search with dense vector search for grounded, cited answers. I built the LangGraph agent pipeline, a streaming FastAPI chat UI, and one-command Docker Compose deployment. Runs locally on Ollama or in the cloud via Groq, OpenRouter, or OpenAI.
outcome: Grounded answers with citations, one-command deploy
highlights: Hybrid retrieval: BM25 + dense embeddings fused with RRF
Agentic pipeline with streaming chat + chunk citations
Runs local on Ollama or cloud via Groq / OpenRouter / OpenAI
